# `aitbc bond resolve-appeal`

Resolve a slash appeal as an admin reviewer. ``accepted`` restores the bond's local eligibility projection only after the coordinator verifies fresh chain state — it never moves funds and never un-burns a sealed on-chain slash. ``rejected`` closes the appeal and leaves the bond untouched.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bond resolve-appeal [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--appeal-id` | text | — | yes | Slash appeal ID to resolve. |
| `--decision` | choice | — | yes | Review decision. |
| `--notes` | text | — | yes | Reviewer notes recorded on the appeal (1-500 chars). |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bond resolve-appeal --appeal-id <appeal_id> --decision <decision> --notes <notes>
```
